notes.title: Patch 1.04 (fixes & sidecar DLC content)
notes.notes:
With the release of the “Sidecar Thrill” DLC comes a brand new patch, fixing various crashes and glitches that have been reported by the community.
You can find the full patch notes below. 

[h1]General improvements and fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added sidecar DLC content
[*]Fixed several collision glitches on the Snaefell Mountain track 
[*]Fixed small undesired elevations on several fantasy tracks (for example, old Blair Forest and Hertfordshire)
[*]Fixed a crash which occurred when changing sections on the Snaefell Mountain Course
[*]Updated fmod version to fix a sound bug which could cause random crashes
[/list]

As always, your feedback is greatly appreciated, so don’t hesitate to share it with us so we can take it into consideration in the future.

notes.title: TT Isle of Man sidecars - 2 riders, 3 ways to play!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31709063/a793183b594800e81e360300fd16267618846b3e.png[/img]

The sidecar update is just around the corner! :)
And this time you won’t be alone on the mountain...

That's right! The update will bring 3 different ways to control your vehicle:
✔ Option 1: Player 1 as Rider - AI as Passenger
✔ Option 2: Player 1 as both Rider AND Passenger (using both analog sticks)
✔ Option 3: Player 1 as Rider - Player 2 as Passenger (and vice versa)

All the Options will be playable offline in single player and couch co-op.
There will be a multiplayer mode where you’ll be able to compete with up to 7 other players using Option 1 or 2. 
Please note that, due to technical matters, the online co-op mode (using Option 3) will be implemented a bit later on. We'll keep you updated on its release date.

notes.title: The Flare Path: Tank Clashes and Manx Dashes
notes.notes: How annoying. As Wikipedia is adamant Field Marshal Wavell didn’t dote on a Manx cat called Matilda during his time in North Africa, and the 1947 TT sidecar race wasn’t won by Rommel’s twin sons riding a stripped-down, souped-up BMW R75, it looks like I’m going to have to introduce this week’s pieces on TT Isle of Man and Desert War 1940-42 with an admission that this week’s pieces on TT Isle of Man and Desert War 1940-42 have flip-all in common. notes.title: TT Patch 1.01 is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31709063/59dde3945480781f6deb07f470dc2bd4d34cdab6.png[/img]

We’ve just released a patch for the PC version of TT.
You can find the full changelog below.

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Trigger feedback for Xbox gamepads are now available on PC
[*]Updated pilot’s animations
[*]In the options menu, "resolution" and "refresh rate" values are now associated with the type of screen selected[/list]

[b]AI[/b]
[list][*]AI pilots are less likely to collide with other vehicles
[*]Increased very slightly AI brake skill 
[*]Adjusted AI turn skill to avoid being too slow during a turn[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed several crashes
[*]Fixed several achievements that did not unlock
[*]In career mode, fixed Tourist Trophy events that did not appear properly
[*]Fixed some achievements that did not unlock properly
[*]We thank you again for your continued feedback and support.[/list]

Thank you for your continued feedback and support!

notes.title: TT Isle of Man will be available tomorrow, from 9AM BST
notes.notes:
Good news for PC gamers! You’ll be able to tackle the legendary Snaefell Mountain from tomorrow, 9AM BST!
And to celebrate the Steam release, the King of the Mountain Pack* will be offered as a free early adopter bonus, if you buy the game within the first 15 days from launch (27th March to 10th April).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31709063/33ade2e2eee5366ddeb1b5fd394d7eb831f678ac.jpg[/img]
*Bonus content:
Bike ➡ Honda CBR1000RR Fireblade with exclusive livery ‘Tribute to Joey Dunlop’
Rider ➡ John McGuiness, with special leather and helmet
